source-code label mapping:
PR92_FAIL block is emitted only by add_graupel_diffusion_mixture when captured qs64/ns64 differ bitwise from graupel_diffusion_point(q1/n1) recomputation. PR92_R64 fields 1-2 are qs64/ns64; fields 3-4 are recomputed qdiff/ndiff; 5-6 are qt/nt promoted to REAL64. In C1 form_candidate, p=4 assigns qs64=REAL(qs,REAL64), ns64=REAL(ns,REAL64), then adds pr87_all_pair_diffusion_delta(7:8). The store-failure writer records those values as the source rates. PR92_DONOR_TERMS has seven q terms then seven n terms; PR92_STENCIL records 3x3 q1 then 3x3 n1 around source center.
